scope: First galaxy channel58 three selected exposures
finding: Baseline residual appears relatively noise-like. Rank1 has localized alternating residual near a neighbour, away from target centre; rank2 has localized structured residual as well. This supports exposure-dependent scene mismatch, but does not identify PSF, registration, source identity or detector cause and does not prove target flux unaffected.
next: Localize residuals against epoch-propagated source positions and target estimator weights; retain flags, compare sensitivity before using these fits.
